meta.parties: Saranankara Unnanse Et Al. v. Indajoti Unnanse Et Al

rules.statement: Presentation for ordination, apart from robing, is sufficient to constitute pupillage.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be added that these functions may validly be performed by delegation, and it would seem that a priest presented for ordination by a priest other than the robing priest in his own name will be the pupil of both. This probably is an instance of pupillage by adoption spoken of by the High Priest in the Matara case."
